description: The plot illustrates how “Reliability Score” varies with “Cost” for three model configurations (3-Model Ensemble, 2-Model Ensemble, and GPT-4) shown as three colored line series. The x-axis is labeled “Cost,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 10 with regularly spaced tick labels every 2 units (0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10). The y-axis is labeled “Reliability Score,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 30 to 90 with labeled ticks at 30, 50, 70, and 90 (20-unit intervals). The 3-Model Ensemble is plotted as a blue solid line with circular markers, decreasing across the three shown cost points from about 83 at cost 0 to about 79 at cost 5 and about 75 at cost 10. The 2-Model Ensemble is plotted as a red solid line with circular markers, decreasing from about 85 at cost 0 to about 80 at cost 5 and about 73 at cost 10. GPT-4 is plotted as a yellow/gold solid line with circular markers, decreasing from about 89 at cost 0 to about 64 at cost 5 and about 40 at cost 10.
